proof_0505.moves: Unwraps the integrality typeclass hypothesis into a pointwise integrality statement, feeds it to the tower theorem that an integral extension of an algebraic extension is algebraic, and repackages the result with the IsAlgebraic constructor.

proof_0506.moves: Pure definitional monotonicity: a vertex cover meets every edge, so any superset of it does too; the real argument is unfolding IsVertexCover and chasing the subset hypothesis, and here it is buried in an auto-generated private lemma.

proof_0507.moves: An auto-generated obligation for the first-isomorphism-theorem equivalence: pair the already-proved injectivity and surjectivity of rangeKerLift into a bijectivity conjunction.

proof_0508.moves: Specializes the general map-invariance theorem to the map given by a constant vadd: measurability of the translation supplies the measurable-map hypothesis and the commuting-action law identifies the pushed-forward action with the original.

proof_0509.moves: A primed variant: upgrades the pointwise bound f x ≤ g x to an eventual bound along the filter, then applies the existing monotonicity lemma for tendsto-to-bottom.

proof_0510.moves: Mechanically derived reassociated form of an existing lemma: whisker the base equation lift_snd_comp_fst_comp on the right by an arbitrary morphism and reassociate. No new mathematics beyond the base lemma and associativity.

proof_0511.moves: Same auto-generated reassociation pattern: take comp₂_iso_inv, whisker it with an arbitrary following morphism and reassociate. The mathematical content lives entirely in the base lemma.

proof_0512.moves: Works at the level of filter pushforward: rewrite map f of the inverted filter as the inverse of map f (using that f is a monoid hom), then apply monotonicity of filter inversion to the hypothesis map f l₁ ≤ l₂, chaining equality into inequality.

proof_0513.moves: The cast of 1 from the nonnegative rationals to the rationals is definitionally 1, so the proof is rfl. There is no mathematical step, only agreement of the two numeral definitions.

proof_0514.moves: The skip? operation on a string position and on the corresponding slice unfold to the same term, so the proof is rfl — pure definitional identity, no argument.

proof_0515.moves: Unfolds ENNReal.ofReal as the coercion of Real.toNNReal, cancels the coercion with coe_le_coe, and reduces the goal to the known iff for toNNReal comparison under nonnegativity.

proof_0516.moves: Both directions go through the cycleOf permutation: membership in the support is characterised by lying in the support of cycleOf, whose support is contained in the support of the permutation, and the converse direction uses symmetry of SameCycle.

proof_0517.moves: States what the seqRight of the Finset applicative instance computes to; both sides unfold to the same definition, so the proof is rfl.

proof_0518.moves: Lifts the goal from the extensional tree map to an underlying representative via the quotient induction principle, then applies the corresponding lookup-after-insert lemma for the raw tree map; the dependent cast is carried along using the compare-equals-eq characterisation.

proof_0519.moves: A simp/definitional lemma recording what the functor from condensed sets to topological spaces does on morphisms; both sides reduce to the same term so the proof is Eq.refl.

proof_0520.moves: Deduces the unlifted statement from the universe-lifted one: apply the lift version of the relrank-comap lemma and cancel the cardinal lift with lift_id.

proof_0521.moves: Realises the bind as a case analysis on the option: computability of option-casesOn with the constant none branch and the given two-argument computable function, then Computable.of_eq to identify the resulting function with Option.bind pointwise.

proof_0522.moves: The integer scalar multiple of a continuous map is defined pointwise, so evaluating it at a point is definitionally the scalar multiple of the value; the proof is rfl.

proof_0523.moves: Pointwise reduction: fix a point of the source set, use that g maps it into the target set, and apply the composition theorem for analytic-within-at at that point.

proof_0524.moves: Rewrites the right-derivability-structure hypothesis through its iff-characterisation and transports the resulting Guitart exactness along the given isomorphism of localizing functors.

proof_0525.moves: Exhibits the subsemigroup inclusion as an additive hom (addition on the subtype is defined componentwise, so map_add is rfl) which is inducing for the subspace topology (also rfl), then transfers separate continuity of addition along that inducing hom.

proof_0526.moves: Specialises the eval₂ version of the sum-over-a-finset lemma to the identity ring hom, which is exactly eval.

proof_0527.moves: Builds the lawfulness instance for the single-character backward pattern by reducing it to the character-predicate pattern (matching a char is testing equality with it) and discharging the two structure fields, endsWith and skipSuffixOfNonempty?, from that instance's laws.

proof_0528.moves: Congruence for the L-series hypothesis: since the two coefficient functions agree away from 0, the L-series and its summability agree, so having a given sum is equivalent; mechanically this is a simp call closing the iff, with the real rewriting packed into a generated private simp lemma.
